item.text: I’ll move the plot map to a post-v1 milestone and remove it from the first-version acceptance criteria. That changes ticket scope and dependencies, so the story setup flow calls for a fresh review of the adjusted package.

The plot map is now **post-v1**. It is removed from the first-version prototype, launch requirements and acceptance criteria. The 40-plot registry and allocation controls remain in v1.

Independent review: approve, invocation R3

The adjusted package contains **15 first-version tickets and one post-v1 ticket**:

| Milestone | Ticket | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|
| Foundation | P01: Application, email and verification tooling | — |
| Foundation | P02: Plots, seasons, households and enrollment | P01 |
| Foundation | P03: Passwordless access and recovery | P01, P02 |
| Foundation | P04: Phone-first prototype, excluding map | — |
| Foundation | P05: Checkpoint: prototype and allocation examples | P04 |
| Allocation | P06: Seasonal applications | P02, P03, P05 |
| Allocation | P07: Allocation rules and safe persistence | P02, P05, P06 |

| Allocation | P09: FCFS waiting list and promotion | P06, P07, P08 |

| Launch | P15: Deployment, recovery and correction procedures | P08, P09, P11, P13, P14 |

The map requirement is explicitly deferred in the coverage map alongside payments and tool lending. P01 and P04 remain the starting work. Checkpoints remain ordinary tickets without mechanically enforced approval gates.

Setup still covers Plotbook’s Python/Django/PostgreSQL metadata, the default Setup phase plus these five milestones, `AGENTS.md`, `RULES.md`, the standard `REVIEW.md`, Git initialization and ignores, and the initial snapshot, setup note and handover.

Quality level: Full pipeline.

| Stage | Proposed command | Setup state |
|---|---|---|
| WRITE_TESTS | `python manage.py test` | Disabled; tooling pending |
| TEST | `python manage.py test` | Disabled; tooling pending |
| BUILD | Deployment artifact command determined in P01 | Disabled; applicability pending |
| VERIFY | `python manage.py runserver 127.0.0.1:8000` | Disabled; application pending |

All other stated assumptions remain unchanged. No project files have been created.

How should I proceed with this setup? Reply **Approve setup**, **Adjust the plan**, or **Inspect details**.

The story skill’s [setup-flow.md](/private/tmp/cc-cpm-w4-t536/onboarding-eval-WQjjxg/home/.agents/skills/story/setup-flow.md) requires: “Nothing is written before approval.” Approval now covers this adjusted package.
